description: This file contains API definitions for managing GRE interface objects within a data model, including functions for CRUD operations, parameter retrieval and setting, and validation for GRE interfaces in a network device management system.

methods.name: CGreIf_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of GRE interface entries.

methods.name: CGreIf_GetEntry
methods.description: Fetches a specific GRE interface entry by index.

methods.name: CGreIf_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new GRE interface entry.

methods.name: CGreIf_DelEntry
methods.description: Deletes a specified GRE interface entry.

methods.name: CGreIf_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Gets a boolean parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CGreIf_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Gets an unsigned long parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CGreIf_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets a string parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CGreIf_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Gets an integer parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CGreIf_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CGreIf_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CGreIf_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CGreIf_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets an integer parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: CGreIf_Validate
methods.description: Validates the configuration parameters before applying changes.

methods.name: CGreIf_Commit
methods.description: Commits the changes to the GRE interface configuration.

methods.name: CGreIf_Rollback
methods.description: Reverts any uncommitted changes to the GRE interface configuration.

methods.name: CGreIfStat_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves statistical unsigned long parameter value for GRE interface.
